_comment: The worked example, generalised off the Demi UGC build. Copy it and replace
the content. target_rate and source_consonant are MEASUREMENTS OF THE REAL
PERSON, taken from her own recording, not defaults: 3.62 words/sec of speech
and a 4.80% share in 2 to 5 kHz. Without them the scorer has nothing to be
Every candidate here is the SAME LINE. That is the point: you are choosing a
model and a stability, not writing four scripts. 'target' is what the
candidate should be HEARD saying, used for transcript verification, and
defaults to the text with tags stripped.
